collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE IV: ROMANCE, COURTSHIP AND WEDDINGS (LCD-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Crushes and courting on Isola: wondering whether someone likes you back, flowers and love songs, first dates, serenades gone wrong, proposals, weddings big and small, how many children, breakups and starting over.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager's first love comes home after years away: rekindle it, or stay friends.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) left Isola ten years ago to live on another island, and today (friend.he/she) has come home. (subject) was (friend.his/her) first love, when they were both young. They are older now, and different. At the welcome feast, they keep catching each other's eye. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) finds (friend) on the beach after the feast. They talk until dawn about the last ten years. It is not the same as it was. It is something new. They decide to find out what.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) decides the past is the past. They become good friends: (friend) is funny and wise in ways (friend.he/she) was not before. Sometimes, (subject) wonders. That is all right.
